description: Na₂BaMgP₂O₈ crystallizes in the trigonal P̅3 space group. Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 85°. There are three shorter (2.42 Å) and one longer (2.44 Å) Na-O bond length. Ba is bonded to twelve O atoms to form BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share edges with six equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, edges with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, edges with six equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and faces with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. There are six shorter (2.82 Å) and six longer (3.11 Å) Ba-O bond lengths. Mg is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, corners with six equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and faces with two equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. All Mg-O bond lengths are 2.10 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and edges with three equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 24°. There is one shorter (1.54 Å) and three longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ba, one Mg, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na, three equivalent Ba, and one P atom.
